note: ebfret_session_means are ebFRET's fitted state means on a background-subtracted 'signal'. This port fits the uncorrected proximity ratio acceptor/(donor+acceptor) in [0,1], so the two well-separated interior states (~0.33 and ~0.516) are the stable cross-tool assertion target; the donor-only level appears near ~0.06-0.09 here instead of ebFRET's ~0.
